checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 6-second 16:9 video of a mountain lake at dusk
must.why: Frames are 826x496 (about 16:9) and show a dusk mountain lake; 6s length is given.

must.item: Gentle ripples visibly animate the water
must.why: Frames show ripples evolving, but they are a large expanding ring rather than subtle gentle ripples.
Mountains and horizon are identical in position across all frames.

must.item: Repeated playback has no perceptible jump
must.why: The last frame at 5.7s matches the first image's calm state, so the loop looks plausible, but I can't verify the actual boundary.

must.item: Centre remains visually calm, no prominent moving objects
must.why: A dark floating blob appears in the centre at 0.6s, then a large concentric ring spreads across the centre at 2.4s and 4.2s, which competes with a heading.

must.item: No visible text and no audible sound
must.why: No text appears in any frame; the assistant says the clip is silent, and sound can't be checked from frames.

faults.what: A dark, odd floating blob (like a puck or ring) appears in the centre of the water at 0.6s, an AI artefact that looks like an object.
A large, strong concentric ripple spreads across the centre of the lake at 2.4s and 4.2s. It is not subtle and sits where a heading would go.
The loop join was not verified. The video appears to start from a calm state, but the 0.6s blob suggests a sudden start event.

summary: The clip is a pretty, static-camera dusk lake, but a strange dark blob and a big central ripple ring break the subtle, calm background the user asked for.
